nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
YuE2 cover (Mac, yue2.cpp)

Keeps the melody of a recording, sings your lyrics in your style.

1. Load Audio: the song to cover (WAV or MP3). Use one you have the rights to.
2. YuE2 Transcribe (melody only) writes its score.
3. YuE2 Song: cot = melody. Lyrics need the same sections as the original ([Verse], [Chorus] ...) and about the same syllables per line. One note per syllable.
4. Queue. Check the transcribed score on the right: strip backing vocals or pickup notes if the cover sings them.

Extend a song instead: un-bypass YuE2 Tokenize, connect codes to Render's source_codes, set source_start/source_end, set cot back to full.

First run downloads SheetSage2 + MERT (1 GB) next to the YuE2 models in models/yue2.
M1 16 GB: a 55 s cover takes about 8 min.
